title: Bell Ringers
summary: Daily writing warm-ups for grades 9–12, with a built-in library of short craft lessons, a five-point rubric, quick grading and Canvas.

steps.caption: The student view. Today’s bell ringer is waiting at the top.
A short craft lesson, a task, and the rubric. Students write right below.

steps.text: Phones in class pull attention away from learning. When a phone buzzes, even students who don’t check it lose their focus for several minutes.

steps.caption: Their writing saves as they type. One click turns it in.
The teacher dashboard. Add a bell ringer from the library in two clicks.
Each bell ringer is a tile. A red number means responses are waiting.
Score each response on the five-point rubric and leave a comment.

steps.text: Clear claim. Add one example from your own day.

steps.caption: Scores and comments save on their own. Push grades to Canvas when you’re ready.
